L136: cite95†GeoJSON files L137: # Voting Precincts
L138: 
L139: * * *
L140: 
L141: Precincts are the basic geographical areas for organizing and administering elections. They are established by the governing body of each city or town, or by the county board in unorganized territories.
L142: 
L143: cite96†Download a spreadsheet of current precincts and their election districts updated through September 18, 2026
L144: 
L145: Precinct data is available in cite93†shapefile, cite94†KML, and cite95†GeoJSON format. updated through September 18, 2026
L146: The list below summarizes major precinct changes since the 2024 general election as of September 18, 2026, Some of these, and many other smaller changes, are as a result of cite97†municipal boundary changes†www.mba.state.mn.us .
L147:   * Beltrami County
L148:     * Removed "Prec" from names of unorganized precincts
L149:   * Brown County
L150:     * Springfield removed their wards and consolidated to one precinct
L151:   * Carlton County
L152:     * "City" added to precinct names of Barnum, Carlton, Moose Lake, and Wrenshall cities
L153:   * Carver County
L154:     * Waconia added P-4 and adjusted all precinct boundaries
L155:   * Cottonwood County
L156:     * Germantown Township consolidated to one precinct
L157:   * Dakota County
L158:     * Cannon Falls annexed into county
L159:     * Small adjustment to Rosemount P-1 and P-4 boundary
L160:     * South St Paul added P-6 and adjusted boundaries of P-3, P-4, and P-6
L161:   * Hennepin County
L162:     * Bloomington W-4 P-31 merged into W-4 P-30
L163:   * Koochiching County
L164:     * Created Bigfork Valley precinct from Dinner Creek and Southwest, to align with hospital district
L165:   * Mower County
L166:     * "City" added to precinct names of many cities
L167:   * Olmsted County
L168:     * Stewartville split into two precincts
L169:   * Rice County
L170:     * "City" added to precinct name of Morristown city
L171:   * St. Louis County
L172:     * Adjustment to Duluth P-33 and P-35 boundary to follow Munger Trail
L173:     * New township (Goodwill Township) organized
L174:     * Numerous changes to precincts in unorganized territory
L175:   * Sherburne County
L176:     * Baldwin township completed the process of becoming a city
L177:   * Stearns County
L178:     * St Cloud W-2 P-8 added due to annexation
L179:   * Washington County
L180:     * No boundary changes, administrative changes only
L181:       * Removed "City" from Birchwood Village precinct name
L182:       * Added leading zero to precincts without wards
